destination.name: Jiangyin
destination.tagline: A Yangtze port city with ancient canal towns and a Ming travel-writer's home
destination.description: Jiangyin is a port city on the south bank of the lower Yangtze and is administered by Wuxi. Its southern towns hold most of the history: Changjing is a canal water town more than 2,000 years old, and Xu Xiake Town is the birthplace of the Ming geographer and travel writer. On the river, Ebizui Park gives views over the Yangtze, which the Jiangyin Fortress system once defended. Wuxi's airport is 40 to 60 minutes away by car.
whyVisit: Wander an ancient canal water town

goodToKnow.title: City sightseeing bus
goodToKnow.detail: A sightseeing bus runs from April to December past the Jiangyin Museum, the Yangtze River Bridge and Huangshan Lake.

goodToKnow.title: Humid summers
goodToKnow.detail: Summer humidity often tops 80% and most rain falls in the plum rain season and summer, so spring and autumn suit best.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Summers are hot, humid and wet, so spring and autumn suit best. Aim for {months}.
